name: Paper Boat
summary: Write a wish on a notebook page, watch it fold itself into a paper boat and sail down the canal
about: A lined notebook page floats above a canal after the rain, with flat-roof houses, a rainbow (or the moon in dark mode) and reeds at the water's edge. Your wish appears on the page as you type; press Fold and sail and the page folds in half, tucks its corners into a hat, opens into a boat with your words on the hull and drops into the water with a splash, then bobs away on real ripples. Good for a wishes or guestbook page, a monsoon campaign or a calm kids page.
how: Type a wish in the box; it is written on the waiting sheet as you type.
Press Fold and sail (or Enter): the sheet folds in three steps into a boat and drops into the canal.
Tap the water to make ripples that rock and push the boats; tap the sky for a breeze that bends the trees.
Each boat that sails out of sight is added to the list below the scene.
With reduced motion the fold is quicker, the sheet does not bob and there is no rain.
